mutations.name: a phone keeps the rail and gets no menu
kills: the shell nav on a phone hides the rail until the menu opens, then lists every route with the current one marked and focused

mutations.name: the drawer marks no route as current
kills: the shell nav on a phone hides the rail until the menu opens, then lists every route with the current one marked and focused

mutations.name: tapping a route leaves the drawer open
kills: the shell nav on a phone closes the menu once a route is tapped and lands on it

mutations.name: Escape before the fade ends leaves the drawer open
kills: the shell nav on a phone closes the menu on Escape and hands focus back to the menu button

mutations.name: a desktop loses the rail too
kills: the shell nav on a phone keeps the rail and no menu button on a desktop
